arabic text: NA BHAJDE GHORAY TOUN GHAZI LAYNDHA\nNA SAR BARAYHNA MAIN SHAAM JAANDI
english translation text: Had Ghazi taken hold of the charging horses,\nI would not have gone bareheaded to Shaam.

arabic text: NA TAUQ GAL VICH SAJJAD PANDA\nNA SAR BAYRAYHNA MAIN SHAAM JAANDI
english translation text: No heavy collar would have been placed around Sajjad’s neck;\nI would not have gone bareheaded to Shaam.

arabic text:
JAY MERAY GHAZI NU TU LAARAN DI
KADI IJAZAAT HUSSAIN DAYNDA
NA KALLAA AKBAR DI LAASH CHAANDA
NA SAR BAREHNA MAIN SHAAM JAANDI
english translation text:
Had you ever permitted my Ghazi
to enter the battle, Hussain,
you would not have lifted Akbar’s body alone;
and I would not have gone bareheaded to Shaam.

arabic text:
JAY MERA GHAZI BHIRA NA MARDA
MAIN SHAAM DAY VICH KADI NA RULDI
NA KOYI BAAGGI DI BHAIN AANDA
NA SAR BAREHNA MAIN SHAAM JAANDI
english translation text:
Had my brother Ghazi not been killed,
I would never have been humiliated in Shaam.
No one would have dared call me the sister of a rebel;
and I would not have gone bareheaded to Shaam.

arabic text:
HUSSAIN RAYEE MERAY DIL CH’ HASRAT
MAIN TERAY LAASHAY TAY VAIN POUNDI
NA JHIRKAN DAYKAY KOYI UTHANDA
NA SAR BAREHNA MAIN SHAAM JAANDI
english translation text:
Hussain, one longing remains in my heart:
to sit beside your body and lament.
No one would have driven me away with rebukes;
and I would not have gone bareheaded to Shaam.

arabic text:
DO JAG DA MUKHTAAR MERA ABID
KAFAN SAKINA DA MANGREYA AY
NA VAKHRI ODEE KABAR BANANDA
NA SAR BAREHNA MAIN SHAAM JAANDI
english translation text:
My Abid, the master of both worlds,
is asking for a shroud for Sakina.
He would not have had to make her separate grave;
and I would not have gone bareheaded to Shaam.
